column7: Read-path cache stale-serve class: a generation stamp read AFTER the data recorded the pre-change answer under the post-change stamp, so it was served until some unrelated write moved that generation again (no TTL to bound it). Found in both PERF-3 caches independently: #2767 a revoked permission kept authorizing, #2764 a rotated secret kept returning its pre-rotation version. Closed by construction, not per-site: one ordered helper (read_path_cache.go cachedRead/cachedReadSameRow) is the only writer of a cache entry, enforced by TestReadPathCacheGuard_RealRepo, and every helper site must have a row in this proving test (TestReadPathCacheRace_EveryHelperSiteHasARow).
